theorem_statement: Independent changes of representative in the fifteen regular V4 chambers transform every character adjacency operator by diagonal sign conjugation. Therefore its spectrum is independent of local representative choice, while raw voltage placements and counts are gauge-dependent.

interpretation.earned: The four 15-channel character operators are intrinsic up to signed similarity. Their spectra are native invariants of the G60 V4-cover rather than artifacts of the chosen chamber origins.
interpretation.discarded: The raw census of edge labels 1, a, b, and ab cannot be treated as an invariant physical distribution.
